title: Refuse a rebase or history rewrite of a lane branch from the batch runner or another lane
why: Runner 11 planned a "rebase of #1159" (q_max lane qmax-stale-rules-specs) on Nov 13; the coordinator stopped it at 11:05 CST. No guard would have: guard.py rule force-push passes a lease with --force-if-includes, and nothing refuses a local rebase of a lane branch. Harm: a rewrite on a lane's branch can drop the lane's commits or invalidate its review record (decision pr-review-record).
source: coordinator 11:05 CST Nov 13; triage read of origin/main hooks/guard.py rule force-push
note: The guard refuses a rebase, reset or amend of a branch that is not the session's own lane branch, and a lease force-push to such a branch, in the batch runner's and lanes' sessions. Red case: the #1159 plan. Express (ruling drain-first-hold part 4: a fix that keeps work landing).
